launcher: three hosts on a private network, one broker each; the client runs on the node-3 host

machines.node-1: 4 vCPU, 7.8 GiB RAM, Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8260 CPU @ 2.40GHz, kernel 6.1.0-18-amd64, ext4 on disk reported as rotational
machines.node-2: 2 vCPU, 1.9 GiB RAM, Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8336C CPU @ 2.30GHz, kernel 6.1.0-18-amd64, ext4 on disk reported as rotational
machines.node-3: 4 vCPU, 3.8 GiB RAM, Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8260 CPU @ 2.40GHz, kernel 6.1.0-40-amd64, ext4 on disk reported as rotational

limitations: one closed-loop request per producer: throughput is latency-bound, not a saturation ceiling
every acknowledged batch waits for acks=all and per-append fsync; no group commit or pipelined client
fsync max is the process lifetime maximum, not per window
